findings.fix: hint: the number, before a noun (not eins)

findings.problem: The hint not counting is misleading, since [one] beer is counting, and it does not rule out the stand-alone counting form eins.
findings.fix: hint: the number, before a noun (not eins)

back.target: a, an; one (before a masculine or neuter noun)

note: This card covers ein as the number one before a noun, and the other card covers ein as the article a, so the two are kept apart only by this hint.
